context_for_next_testing_agent: Wave 1 PO QR regression fully retested on BC-2026-213. All assertions passed: .qr-sheet mounted (8 imgs), first QR src contains 'data=' and '%2Fscan%3Fsku%3D', console remained visible after qr-print click (aside present, body length unchanged at 1814). rca of the issue: RCA from iteration 33 false negative: the Fragment wrap was already committed but HMR/preview had stale JS cached. A fresh browser context in this iteration (new Playwright context, no cached SW) confirmed the fix is in effect. The <> at line 109 and </> at line 113 wrap <PoDetail/>, {labels && <LabelsPrintModal/>}, {receive && <BlindReceive/>} as a single returned fragment — React no longer reconciles-away the modal portal when PoDetail re-renders, so clicking po-qr no longer blanks the console.
